name: mbx
description: Unofficial mailbox.org access: mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, files and settings.
long_description: Runs the unofficial mbx CLI as a local MCP server. Each tool call runs one mbx command with the same delete protection, read-only mode and request pacing as the CLI. Read-only mode is on by default. Mail and other account data contain text from other people; a model can follow instructions hidden in that text, so check each approval. Not affiliated with mailbox.org or Open-Xchange.

tools.name: mbx_commands
tools.description: List mbx command groups and operations

tools.name: mbx_describe
tools.description: Show the arguments of one mbx operation

tools.name: mbx_read
tools.description: Run an operation that only reads data

tools.name: mbx_write
tools.description: Run an operation that changes data but does not delete it (not offered in read-only mode)

tools.name: mbx_delete
tools.description: Run an operation that deletes data (not offered in read-only mode)

tools.name: mbx_mail_list
tools.description: List the newest messages of a folder

tools.name: mbx_mail_search
tools.description: Search messages by words in subject, addresses or body

tools.name: mbx_mail_correspondents
tools.description: Find the email addresses of a person or company in past mail

tools.name: mbx_mail_read
tools.description: Read one message's body text, attachment list and routing headers

tools.name: mbx_mail_attachment
tools.description: Read an attachment as text (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT, HTML, text) or base64

tools.name: mbx_mail_thread
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation across folders, Sent included

tools.name: mbx_mail_senders
tools.description: List the addresses the account may send from

tools.name: mbx_mail_draft
tools.description: Save a message or a threaded reply in Drafts without sending it (not offered in read-only mode)

tools.name: mbx_mail_move
tools.description: Move one message, for example to the trash (not offered in read-only mode)

tools.name: mbx_events_list
tools.description: List calendar events, by default for the next 30 days

tools.name: mbx_contacts_list
tools.description: List contacts of the default address book

password.title: mailbox.org password
password.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the session from "mbx login" in a terminal. Claude Desktop stores it in the system keychain.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Offer only tools that read data. Turn off to allow changes; then configure delete protection in ~/.mbx/config.toml.
